name: Tidepools

banner.scene: A sunlit rock shelf at low tide: shallow pools full of starfish and anemones, small waves lapping the edge, a wide pale sky above.
details: Three or four separate pools at different depths, each catching a different bit of sky
Tiny crab and starfish silhouettes that can sit in the foreground
Wet footprints leading in from the left edge, where the creature starts walking
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: Warm shallows where every pool hides something small and splashy.

name: Ember Caves

banner.scene: The mouth of a volcanic cave glowing orange from inside: cracked black rock, rivers of slow lava, drifting sparks, a few green ferns growing at the cool edge.
banner.mood: Warm, a little dangerous, welcoming at the edges
details: Glowing cracks that run across the whole strip like a path
A few floating sparks that can drift upward in the loop
A small cool pocket of green on the right edge so the cave feels lived in
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: A warm tunnel of glowing rock where something is always humming.

name: Verdant Hollow

banner.scene: A sunken forest bowl with tall mossy trunks, shafts of light through leaves, a little stream and mushrooms in the foreground.
details: Several layers of trees so the strip has depth from front to back
One or two light shafts falling at an angle
A trail of flat stones crossing the stream from left to right
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: A green bowl in the hills where the trees seem to lean in and listen.

name: Storm Ridge

banner.scene: A bare mountain ridge under a purple thundercloud: rocky steps, lightning striking a far peak, wind-bent grass and a few standing stones.
details: A single bright bolt in the distance that can flash in the loop
Standing stones along the ridge line like waypoints
Grass blowing in one direction, against the walking creature
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: A windy ridge where the air tingles and the thunder is close enough to touch.

name: Sunken Fen

banner.scene: A flat bog at dusk under pale mist: pools of black water with an oily sheen, banks of peat and ochre reeds, a half-sunk cart wheel and signpost, and a half-sunk stone arch at the far end.
banner.mood: Still, damp and patient, with a little gold in it
details: An oily rainbow sheen drifting on the black pools
A half-sunk cart wheel, a leaning signpost and a stone arch: things the bog kept
Clusters of cattail reeds, their dark heads against the pale mist
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: A flat, quiet bog where the mud keeps everything it is given. Old things turn up here.

name: Old Crossroads

banner.scene: A worn dirt crossing where four paths meet, with a crooked wooden signpost, a stone well, a lantern post and travellers' campfire ashes.
banner.mood: Dusty, friendly and full of possibilities
details: A signpost with four arrows, each pointing along a different path
Four paths in four slightly different colours that fade into the distance
Footprints and cart tracks, so it looks well used
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: Four old roads meet here, and a little of everything wanders through.

name: Moonlit Reef

banner.scene: A shallow reef at night under a huge pale moon: glowing coral, drifting jellyfish lights, silver ripples and a thin line of aurora far above.
banner.mood: Dreamy, quiet and a little magical
details: The moon reflected in the water as a long broken stripe
Glowing coral shapes that light the foreground from below
A faint aurora ribbon at the top edge
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: Only the night tide uncovers this reef, and it glows when nobody looks.

name: Festival Grounds

banner.scene: A meadow set up for a festival: strings of paper lanterns between poles, bunting, a small bonfire, long picnic tables and fireworks starting in the sky.
banner.mood: Joyful, warm and a bit noisy
details: Lines of lanterns that curve across the whole strip
A bonfire at the right edge as the finish line
One or two small fireworks that can burst in the loop
never: Any creature drawn in the scene

flavor: The lanterns are lit and the music has started: the whole meadow is a party.
